name: Exp_Stochastic_Histogram
summary: This EA trades based on the Stochastic Histogram custom indicator, supporting two signal modes: level-based (overbought/oversold) and crossover-based. It opens buy positions when the stochastic signals bullish momentum and sell positions when bearish momentum is detected, with configurable position closing on opposite signals. Money management is handled via the included TradeAlgorithms library with multiple margin modes.
summary_zh: 该EA基于Stochastic Histogram自定义指标进行交易，支持两种信号模式：基于超买超卖水平和基于交叉信号。当随机指标显示看涨动量时开多仓，显示看跌动量时开空仓，并在反向信号时可平仓。资金管理通过内置TradeAlgorithms库实现，支持多种保证金模式。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于Stochastic Histogram指标的动量信号进行交易决策。入场条件有两种模式：Levels模式下，当柱状图从0区上穿时开多仓，从2区下穿时开空仓；Cross模式下，当上轨线上穿下轨线时开多仓，下穿上时开空仓。出场条件通过反向信号触发，BuyPosClose和SellPosClose参数控制是否在反向信号时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数(LOT)模式，但也支持基于余额、可用保证金等多种资金管理模式。止损设为1000点，止盈设为2000点，风险收益比为1:2。信号判定使用SignalBar参数指定的K线，默认为前一根已收盘K线，避免了未收盘K线的 repaint 问题。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on momentum signals from the Stochastic Histogram custom indicator. Entry conditions operate in two modes: in Levels mode, buy signals trigger when the histogram column crosses above zone 0 and sell signals trigger when it crosses below zone 2; in Cross mode, buy signals occur when the upper line crosses above the lower line and sell signals on the opposite crossover. Exit conditions are triggered by opposing signals, with BuyPosClose and SellPosClose parameters controlling whether positions are closed on reversal signals. Position sizing defaults to a fixed lot mode (LOT) but also supports multiple money management modes including balance-based and free margin-based allocation. Stop loss is set at 1000 points and take profit at 2000 points, yielding a risk-reward ratio of 1:2. Signal evaluation uses the SignalBar parameter (default bar 1, the last closed bar) which avoids repaint issues from using the current unclosed bar.

parameters.description_en: Allow closing short on reverse signal

pros: 双模式信号系统（水平线/交叉）提供灵活的交易策略选择
使用已收盘K线(SignalBar=1)判断信号，避免repaint问题
新K线检测机制(IsNewBar)避免同一根K线内重复交易
1:2的风险收益比设计合理，长期期望值为正
独立的买卖开关允许只做多或只做空，适合趋势过滤
多种资金管理模式适应不同风险偏好
pros_en: Dual-mode signal system (Levels/Cross) provides flexible strategy selection
Uses closed bar (SignalBar=1) for signal evaluation, avoiding repaint issues
New bar detection mechanism (IsNewBar) prevents duplicate trades within the same bar
1:2 risk-reward ratio is reasonably designed for positive long-term expectancy
Independent buy/sell switches allow long-only or short-only trading for trend filtering
Multiple money management modes accommodate different risk preferences
cons: 止损1000点和止盈2000点固定值过大，未考虑市场波动率(ATR)自适应
依赖自定义指标Stochastic_Histogram，增加了部署复杂性和失败风险
缺乏点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能产生不利成交
没有最大持仓数量限制，可能在震荡市中连续开仓导致过度交易
Static变量在EA重启后状态丢失，可能导致信号遗漏
缺少回撤控制和最大亏损限制机制
cons_en: Fixed 1000-point SL and 2000-point TP are excessively large without ATR-based volatility adaptation
Depends on custom Stochastic_Histogram indicator, increasing deployment complexity and failure risk
No spread filter, which may lead to unfavorable fills in high-spread environments
No maximum position count limit, potentially causing overtrading in choppy markets
Static variables lose state on EA restart, potentially missing signals
Lacks drawdown control and maximum loss limit mechanisms
improvements: 引入ATR动态止损止盈，根据市场波动率自适应调整
增加点差过滤和最大持仓数量限制，减少不利成交和过度交易
添加回撤控制和资金曲线保护机制，如最大回撤百分比熔断
improvements_en: Introduce ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit for volatility-adaptive position management
Add spread filter and maximum position count limit to reduce unfavorable fills and overtrading
Implement drawdown control and equity curve protection mechanisms such as max drawdown percentage circuit breaker

risk_points: 固定大止损(1000点)在低波动品种上风险过大，在高波动品种上又可能过小
缺乏回撤控制机制，极端行情下可能持续亏损
自定义指标加载失败时仅打印日志返回INIT_FAILED，无容错重试机制
无点差过滤，在流动性差时段可能遭受严重滑点
risk_points_en: Fixed large stop loss (1000 points) is excessive for low-volatility instruments and insufficient for high-volatility ones
No drawdown control mechanism, risking sustained losses during extreme market conditions
Custom indicator load failure only prints a log and returns INIT_FAILED with no retry/fallback mechanism
No spread filter, potentially suffering severe slippage during low-liquidity sessions
